dispositions.input: copy-webpack-plugin 11 static directory copying and owned build cache options
dispositions.reason: Docusaurus static copying configures no transform/cache callback. No attacker-created RegExp/Date object is serialized then evaluated; cache-key strings are not executed JavaScript.
dispositions.action: No fix inside the consumers' ranges on 2026-11-09: Docusaurus 3.10.2 (latest) asks for copy-webpack-plugin ^11, which asks for serialize-javascript ^6. Move the docs chain to >=7.0.5 when Docusaurus does, or qualify an override on a docs build.

dispositions.action: Same docs serializer chain to >=7.0.5 (no fix inside Docusaurus 3.10.2's ranges on 2026-11-09); reassess external object/config sources.

dispositions.input: copy-webpack-plugin 11 cache keys and css-minimizer-webpack-plugin 5 worker options in the docs build
dispositions.reason: The XSS needs attacker-controlled function source text (a spoofed toString ending in </script) whose serialized output is embedded in an HTML script element. Both docs callers serialize owned build options into cache keys or worker messages, never into page markup.
dispositions.action: Update the docs copy-plugin/minimizer serializer chain to serialize-javascript >=7.1.3; Docusaurus 3.10.2 (latest on 2026-11-09) still asks for copy-webpack-plugin ^11 and css-minimizer-webpack-plugin ^5.

dispositions.input: Tracked repository images in explicit Docusaurus docs build
dispositions.reason: libvips decoding flaws matter on malicious bytes. This occurrence decodes reviewed docs assets only; no upload/remote-fetch/product-preview path feeds it. Filename extensions alone are not validation. Untrusted images or credential-bearing docs builds require high-impact reassessment.
dispositions.action: Both consumers still ask for sharp ^0.32.3 in Docusaurus 3.10.2 (latest on 2026-11-09). Qualify them on Sharp >=0.35.5 with native image output when Docusaurus moves, or through a qualified override.

dispositions.input: @rollup/plugin-node-resolve's own frozen defaults; @svgr/plugin-svgo declares the package but never imports it
dispositions.reason: Prototype poisoning needs an attacker-supplied source object in a merge. The only call, deepMerge({}, defaults) in plugin-node-resolve, merges its hardcoded defaults; no build configuration, docs content or user input reaches it.
dispositions.action: No fixed version exists (4.3.1 is the latest on 2026-11-09); move to a fixed release when one ships, reassess if a caller merges external objects.
